body:
Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?: In-game

Staff Member: Junr

Guilty? (Yes or No): Yes

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: Hello, I was banned from Avicus before 5 months ago, I'd like to appeal it, I do not hack anymore, I quit hacking before like 4 months ago, It's very sad to see YouTube videos about avicus and see the new updates while others playing it and i can't play it, I want an unban because i really want to play on the server again, My ign now is WorldTime, I'd even buy gold/diamond rank when i have enough money, I'm grinding money to buy the gold or diamond rank when i get unbanned, I won't hack anymore, I promise, And i'm also sorry that i ruined Avicus fun when i hacked, I just don't hack anymore, I hope i get an unban, I'd not do that dirty thing again! Btw my ign is WorldTime, Thank you very much for taking your time and reading this, Hope the best, Good Bye.

Any additional comments?: My ign is WorldTime now
